title: Iranian Foreign Minister Blames Security Breach for Attack on Ayatollah's Residence
summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Seyyed Abbas Araghchi has blamed a security breach for the attack on Ayatollah Ali Khamenei's residence, which occurred on February 28. The breach allegedly provided attackers with precise knowledge of Khamenei's schedule and high-level meetings taking place at the compound. This incident highlights concerns about national security in Iran.
summary_points: Iranian Foreign Minister Seyyed Abbas Araghchi has attributed the attack on Ayatollah Ali Khamenei's residence to a security breach.
The breach allegedly provided attackers with precise knowledge of Khamenei's schedule and high-level meetings taking place at the compound.
This incident highlights concerns about national security in Iran.
Araghchi has warned that the security breach may still exist, posing ongoing risks to the country.
The attack on Khamenei's residence is a significant concern for Iran's national security and stability.
title_hi: अयोध्या में बमबारी के पीछे सुरक्षा हेरफेर की जिम्मेदारी
summary_hi: संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका और इज़राइल के विदेश मंत्रियों ने दावा किया है कि बमबारी के पीछे सुरक्षा हेरफेर की जिम्मेदारी थी।
summary_points_hi: अयोध्या में बमबारी के पीछे सुरक्षा हेरफेर की जिम्मेदारी थी।
सुरक्षा हेरफेर ने हमलावरों को कामयाब बनाया।
यह घटना भारतीय राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा और स्थिरता पर चिंताएं उठाती है।
अरघची ने सुरक्षा हेरफेर की जारूरी की बात कही है, जिससे देश को खतरा है।
आयतोल्लाह अली खामेनई के घर में बमबारी एक महत्वपूर्ण चिंता है भारतीय राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा और स्थिरता के लिए.

framing.center: Centrist coverage frames the story by focusing on the attack itself, its consequences, and the Iranian government's response. They provide some context about the security breach but do not delve deeply into its implications.
framing.right: Right-leaning outlets focus on the potential foreign involvement in the attack, emphasizing the need for increased scrutiny of Iran's national security and the role of external powers.
